body.justification: The exact-image question remains after two distinct collision-uniform estimation routes: the auxiliary class-advised admissible-summary net and the operative no-advice structured lattice with its computable outer report.
body.gap: Neither the precomputed admissible-summary library nor the data-only structured lattice gives an exact finite representation of \(\mathcal K\), black-box-free evaluation of \(\overline F\), or exact extrema of the original summary-inversion image.
body.consumer: A solution would sharpen computation of the original theoretical image and its extrema; it is not needed for the K1--K4 deliverables, which use the no-advice structured lattice and its honest outer report.

obligation.what_is_open: Whether the original sharp summary-inversion image and its support-dependent cluster extrema can be computed exactly, or by a sharp representation, in time polynomial in \(n\) in the fixed-dimensional exact-real model.
obligation.obstruction: The gap-free modulus proves continuity of \(\overline F\) on the compact closure \(\mathcal K\), but supplies no finite exact description of \(\mathcal K\) and no black-box-free algorithm for evaluating \(\overline F\) throughout the summary ball.  The class-advised net discretizes admissible summaries only to \(n^{-1/2}\) accuracy, while the no-advice lattice constructs an outer \(W_1\)-ball rather than the exact image; consequently neither result yields the exact image or its exact support-dependent extrema.
obligation.attempted: Use the abstract modulus with a precomputed admissible-summary net, and separately use the structured positive-law lattice followed by finite-dimensional transport and cluster-mass optimization.  These routes close estimation, coverage, and reporting but deliberately replace exact continuum inversion by approximation or an honest outer set.
obligation.partial_result:
The computable surrogate and the auxiliary benchmark are complete.  By \(\mathrm{thm:polynomial\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\), the class-advised estimator \(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}}\) is a total positive real-law-valued Borel map and satisfies
\[
W_1(\widehat\nu_n^{\mathrm{net}},\nu_P)\le C_{\mathrm{mod}}\{2d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P))+n^{-1/2}\},
\]
so the abstract gap-free modulus alone yields collision-uniform root-\(n\) estimation from a precomputed admissible-summary net.  Independently, \(\mathrm{prop:polynomial\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\) makes \(\widehat\lambda_n\) a no-advice total positive real-law-valued estimator obtained by exhaustive minimization over a structured lattice of cardinality polynomial in \(n\) for fixed \(k,d_x,d_z\).  By \(\mathrm{thm:honest\text{-}root\text{-}n\text{-}confidence}\), \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{alg}}_{n,\alpha}\) is honest and has \(W_1\)-diameter at most \(2R_{n,\alpha}\).  By \(\mathrm{def:cluster\text{-}report}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:cluster\text{-}adaptive\text{-}report}\), every interval \(I_C\) and the full report \(\mathfrak R_{n,\alpha}\) have explicit fixed-dimensional constrained-program representations with the stated support and mass guarantees.  Thus the no-advice lattice dominates the advised net for the operative K1--K4 computational deliverable, and an evaluable honest outer set and report exist even when the raw empirical operator has nonreal eigenpairs.  Only exact computation of the original sharper summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains unresolved.

body.proof_tex: The computable surrogate is already complete. By \(\mathrm{prop:polynomial\text{-}net\text{-}law\text{-}estimator}\), \(\widehat\lambda_n\) is a total, positive, real-law-valued estimator obtained by exhaustive minimization over a lattice of cardinality polynomial in \(n\) for fixed \(k,d_x,d_z\). By \(\mathrm{thm:honest\text{-}root\text{-}n\text{-}confidence}\), \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{alg}}_{n,\alpha}\) is honest and has \(W_1\)-diameter at most \(2R_{n,\alpha}\). By \(\mathrm{def:cluster\text{-}report}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:cluster\text{-}adaptive\text{-}report}\), every reported interval \(I_C\) and the full report \(\mathfrak R_{n,\alpha}\) have explicit fixed-dimensional constrained-program representations with the stated support and mass guarantees. Hence an evaluable honest outer set and report exist even for summaries with nonreal raw empirical spectra; only exact computation of the original sharper summary-inversion image and its exact extrema remains unresolved.
